title: John Lennon and Yoko Ono attend party in Washington, DC | 1972
content:
John Lennon and Yoko Ono attended a party thrown for them in Washington, DC on 9 May 1972.

The party was arranged by Steve Martindale, previously a fundraiser for Republican senator Charles Goodell. It was held at Martindale’s house, and was attended by various politicians and members of the media.

He told us that he lived in Washington, that he used to work on the Hill for Senator Charles Goodell, and that he could introduce us to a lot of important people who might be able to help. If we came down to Washington, he said he’d have a party for us to meet them and invite the press so we’d get publicity for our cause.
John Lennon
The Washington Post, 23 June 1974
